By the pregnant camels, which are followed by their young, and which were the most precious possessions of the Arabs at that time, He draws attention to whatever is similar to them in meaning among all that is precious. ﴿And when the wild beasts are gathered﴾, that is, they will be brought together for the Day of Resurrection, so that Allah may take retribution from some of them on behalf of others, and show His servants the perfection of His justice, to the extent that He will take retribution for the hornless sheep from the horned sheep, and then it will be said to them: "Be dust!" ﴿And when the seas are set ablaze﴾, that is, they will be kindled so that, despite their vastness, they become fire blazing fiercely. ﴿And when the souls are paired﴾, that is, every doer of deeds will be joined with his like: the righteous will be gathered with the righteous and the wicked with the wicked; the believers will be paired with the wide-eyed maidens (hur 'ayn), and the disbelievers with the devils. This is like the saying of the Most High: ﴿And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups﴾, ﴿And those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups﴾, ﴿Gather those who did wrong and their companions﴾. ﴿And when the buried infant girl is asked﴾: she is the one whom the Age of Ignorance (al-Jahiliyyah al-Jahla') used to do, burying daughters alive for no reason except fear of poverty.
